intro: At Sentinel Hill, Thor keeps Westfall linked to Stormwind by gryphon flight. His trained mounts carry travelers and urgent messages above the dangerous roads.

p: Thor tends the gryphon roost at Sentinel Hill, linking Westfall's defenders with the rest of the kingdom. The People's Militia faces bandits, gnolls, and malfunctioning harvest golems on the ground. Thor's gryphons carry travelers and military dispatches above the perilous roads. Reports from Gryan Stoutmantle and urgent requests for aid can reach the court in Stormwind far faster than a ground messenger.
